name: Ranger Burning Toxin scales with 10% melee attack power (#7189)
contract: Burning Toxin coating 808029 promises auto attacks a 30% chance to deal ${$570245m1+$570245ppl1+$AP*0.1} Fire damage through proc 570245 (effect 0 SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE, Fire, DBC base 11 + DieSides 1 with 0.75 per level, zero EffectBonusMultiplier, no spell_bonus_data row), so procs dealt only base plus level scaling: about 39 on dummies against a 129 tooltip at the reporter's attack power. $AP is melee attack power: Skullpiercer writes $RAP*0.25+$AP*.1 and implements 0.25 * ranged + 0.10 * melee, and the sibling Nerve Venom fix (#7190) established the same reading for its $AP term. The proc carries the ranged weapon mask, so native ap_bonus would select ranged attack power (wrong stat); the fix is a guarded script adding 0.10 * melee attack power on effect 0. Two direct casts with +1000 melee and ranged attack power (aura 10031) must deal 200-360 non-critical damage total (about 39 + 100 per cast); expected before the fix: about 39 per cast. A ranged-only control (Aspect of the Hawk 13165) must not move the native spell_damage_done query, rejecting a ranged-based SQL shortcut and guarding against a future SQL row double-dipping with the script.
